name: Cloud Support Engineer
title: Senior Cloud Support Engineer
requirements: Possess a strong foundational knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Demonstrate proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and command-line interface operations. Exhibit deep understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and load balancing. Show expertise in scripting and automation using languages like Python, Bash, or PowerShell to streamline tasks. Hold relevant industry certifications such as AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or Azure Administrator Associate. Maintain a solid grasp of virtualization technologies and containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes. Develop troubleshooting skills to diagnose complex infrastructure, connectivity, and application-level issues. Possess strong analytical thinking to identify root causes in distributed cloud environments.
responsibilities: Provide high-level technical support to resolve complex issues related to cloud infrastructure and services. Monitor cloud environment health and performance using various observability and monitoring tools. Assist in the deployment, configuration, and scaling of cloud-based resources and applications. Collaborate with DevOps and Engineering teams to implement best practices for system stability. Manage user access, identity, and permission settings via IAM frameworks to ensure security. Document technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and permanent fixes in a centralized knowledge base. Coordinate with third-party vendors to resolve escalated hardware or software service disruptions. Participate in on-call rotations and incident response procedures to maintain high system availability.

name: AI Tooling Engineer
title: AI Tooling Engineer
requirements: Demonstrate proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java to build robust automation frameworks. Possess a deep understanding of machine learning workflows, including data preprocessing, model training, and deployment pipelines. Exhibit expertise in software engineering best practices such as CI/CD, version control (Git), and unit testing. Show familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for managing AI workloads. Maintain knowledge of ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX to facilitate tool integration. Understand distributed computing concepts and hardware acceleration (GPUs/TPUs) to optimize model performance. Hold a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. Exhibit strong problem-solving skills to debug complex interactions between software tools and AI models.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain internal tools and platforms to streamline the machine learning development lifecycle. Build automated testing and evaluation frameworks to ensure model quality and reliability. Integrate various AI/ML tools into existing software development pipelines and workflows. Optimize resource utilization for large-scale model training and inference tasks through performance tuning. Collaborate with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to translate research needs into scalable engineering solutions. Develop data ingestion and management pipelines to support automated model training processes. Monitor the health and performance of AI infrastructure, addressing bottlenecks in real-time. Document tool specifications, usage guides, and architectural designs for internal stakeholder adoption.

name: AI Engineer
title: AI Engineer
requirements: Demonstrate advanced proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or C++ for algorithm development. Possess a deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, including supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning. Exhibit expertise in mathematical concepts such as linear algebra, calculus, probability, and statistics. Show familiarity with deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras to build neural networks. Maintain knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or other specialized AI domains. Understand data engineering principles to handle large-scale datasets and complex data pipelines. Exhibit strong problem-solving skills to optimize model accuracy, latency, and scalability. Hold a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and deploy sophisticated machine learning models to solve complex business problems. Implement and optimize data preprocessing pipelines to ensure high-quality input for model training. Conduct rigorous experimentation and testing to evaluate model performance against key metrics. Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions. Work with data engineers to build scalable infrastructure for large-scale model training and inference. Monitor deployed models in production to detect drift, bias, and performance degradation. Research and integrate cutting-edge AI techniques and state-of-the-art papers into existing products. Document model architectures, training methodologies, and deployment processes for team transparency.

name: Automation Engineer
title: Automation Engineer
requirements: Demonstrate proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C# to develop robust automation scripts. Exhibit deep knowledge of software testing frameworks like Selenium, Playwright, or Appium for automated testing. Show expertise in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions to automate deployment pipelines. Maintain a strong understanding of version control systems like Git for managing automation codebases. Possess familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible for environment provisioning. Exhibit strong analytical skills to identify, reproduce, and troubleshoot complex software defects. Hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Demonstrate familiarity with SQL and database management to automate data validation tasks.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and implement automated testing frameworks to increase software quality and release velocity. Create and maintain automated scripts for regression, functional, and integration testing suites. Integrate automated tests into the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. Collaborate closely with QA and Development teams to define automation scope and test cases. Perform regular maintenance of existing automation scripts to ensure compatibility with new software versions. Analyze test results and generate detailed reports to communicate defect trends to stakeholders. Develop automated tools for environment setup, data generation, and system health monitoring. Participate in regular code reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of automation best practices.

name: Software Engineer
title: Software Engineer
requirements: Demonstrate proficiency in one or more core programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript. Exhibit a strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and fundamental computer science principles. Show expertise in software design patterns and object-oriented programming (OOP) methodologies. Maintain familiarity with relational databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL, as well as NoSQL solutions. Possess experience with version control systems, specifically Git, and collaborative development workflows. Exhibit knowledge of web technologies including RESTful APIs and microservices architectures. Show familiarity with testing frameworks and unit testing practices to ensure code quality. Hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain high-quality software applications and systems according to technical specifications. Write clean, efficient, and scalable code that adheres to established coding standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and other engineers. Participate in the full software development life cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis to deployment. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance bottlenecks in production environments. Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure quality and share knowledge within the engineering team. Document technical designs, API specifications, and system architectures for future maintenance. Work closely with DevOps to automate deployment processes and manage application environments.

name: Software Developer
title: Software Developer
requirements: Demonstrate proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#. Exhibit a strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) principles and methodologies. Show expertise in database management, including SQL and familiarity with NoSQL systems. Maintain knowledge of version control tools like Git for collaborative coding. Possess a solid grasp of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and API integration. Exhibit strong problem-solving skills to debug code and resolve technical issues efficiently. Show familiarity with testing methodologies, including unit testing and integration testing. Hold a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
responsibilities: Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code to develop new software applications and features. Analyze user requirements to design and implement effective software solutions. Collaborate with team members, including designers and product managers, to define project scopes. Perform regular debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software defects. Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to quality standards and best practices. Document software specifications, user manuals, and technical processes for internal use. Assist in the deployment of applications and the maintenance of existing software systems. Work closely with QA engineers to ensure software meets all functional requirements.

name: Operations Engineer
title: Operations Engineer
requirements: Demonstrate proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration and command-line operations. Exhibit strong knowledge of networking protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and load balancing. Show expertise in scripting and automation using languages like Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Maintain familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Possess understanding of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. Exhibit strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose complex hardware, software, and network issues. Show familiarity with monitoring and observability tools like Prometheus, Grafance, or ELK stack. Hold a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
responsibilities: Manage and maintain the reliability, availability, and performance of production systems and infrastructure. Monitor system health and implement proactive measures to prevent downtime or service degradation. Automate repetitive operational tasks to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors. Collaborate with development teams to support the deployment of new software and services. Manage user access, security configurations, and identity management within the infrastructure. Perform regular system updates, patches, and backups to ensure data integrity and security. Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response efforts during critical outages. Document system configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides for the team.
